title: Correct final charge
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the charge Q must be approximately 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ C.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Newton's first law to sphere B, resolving forces parallel to the incline or in horizontal/vertical components.

title: Coulomb's law application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Coulomb's law (F = kQ²/r²) to relate the electrostatic force to the unknown charge and the separation distance.

title: Correct geometry/distance
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the horizontal separation L between the spheres using the given vertical height and the 30° angle, finding L = 10√3 cm.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student should demonstrate consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm to m, g to kg) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly resolves the weight or Coulomb force, e.g., using sin/cos of the angle incorrectly in the equilibrium equation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misidentifies the direction of the Coulomb force (repulsive) or makes a sign error in the force balance.
